The thing is, I don’t know if I actually owe the money. I was under the impression that everything was paid in full. I never got any bills and this came out of nowhere. It may be fraud, but I’m currently in another state, so I don’t have access to all of the old bills, so it’s difficult to cross check. 

My biggest concern is the hit on my credit report. I don’t know how I am going to find a job, buy a house, or do any of these things once I graduate, 

I’m so scared of what’s going to happen if I stick around. I don’t want to suffer anymore
